verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover PBR materials, Lumen as the default fully dynamic global illumination and reflections system, Nanite virtualized geometry, and post-process effects such as depth of field, auto exposure and bloom. Community hands-on reports back this up, describing beautiful lighting and good software-ray-traced results on a GTX 1060. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of the shadowing system in the evidence pack.
